opening.argument: The video presents a clearly identified Dog Days movie prize pack, including a $50 Fandango card and themed merchandise such as a T-shirt, bandana, bag, and collapsible bowl. It explains that viewers can enter through a blog widget for a chance to win, stating, "There's a widget on there that you can enter for your chance to win this." The listed actions are ordinary channel engagement: "Entries include liking this video, subscribing to us on YouTube, commenting and sharing this video." Nothing in the described entry process requires financial participation; it is a conventional promotional giveaway built around blog and video interactions.
